baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins eyes enclosed from the reminder to an inability to perform samʿ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visual barrier is specified relationally as being from the reminder, while hearing names understanding and compliance as well as sound perception. Capacity is therefore blocked at the point where reminder would become receptive response, not merely at two unrelated sense organs.

activation_trace.role: The seeing organ supplies the visual channel that is placed inside the obstruction.
A covering literally screens what lies beneath and functions as the visual barrier.
A reminder makes something present again and identifies the blocked content rather than an absent stimulus.
Capacity and effective ability locate the failure in making receptive hearing occur.
Hearing as understanding, acceptance, and compliance supplies the response that cannot be completed.

changed_reading.before: They suffer a generic combination of blindness and deafness.
changed_reading.after: Their perceptual system cannot convert an available reminder into recognition and compliant understanding.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired kānat and kānū clauses hold both the covered eyes and failed hearing in one stated condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The eyes are not said merely to meet a passing obstacle; they are in a covering whose branch image can overwhelm what lies beneath. The repeated state construction makes enclosure and failed auditory uptake a configuration of being.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time frame both sensory clauses as one established condition.
Something rising or abounding until it covers what is below turns the barrier into an enveloping medium.
Direct eyewitnessing supplies the mode of access that enclosure prevents.
Auditory perception supplies the second access channel held inside the same state description.

changed_reading.before: A momentary distraction keeps them from attending.
changed_reading.after: They inhabit an enclosing perceptual condition in which neither witnessing nor receptive hearing gains purchase.

context_deltas.mechanism: An operative blast precedes the focus and is followed by successful gathering. This makes the focus denial sharper if samʿ is the responsive understanding or obedience that sound should elicit, rather than bare arrival of sound at an ear.

activation_trace.role: Sending air into something supplies the blast that makes an acoustic event operative in the scene.
The horn of blowing specifies the instrument and makes the contrast with denied hearing concrete.
Joining the dispersed into a gathered whole shows that the preceding event has an effective outcome.
Understanding and compliance identify the kind of hearing still absent despite the operative blast.

structural_cues: 18:99 places the blown horn and gathering two ayat before the focus, so the local scene already contains effective sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a blown horn, gathering, and samʿ as understanding or compliance; I infer that the negation targets receptive uptake. A live alternative is that divine gathering requires no auditory registration at all.

changed_reading.before: They are physiologically unable to register sound.
changed_reading.after: Sound can operate around and upon them, yet it cannot become understanding, acceptance, or obedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning object is emphatically displayed, while the named audience carries a covering branch and the focus locates covering at their eyes. Evidence can therefore be fully exposed while recognition remains blocked at the receiver.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something out for viewing supplies public exposure rather than hidden evidence.
Covering or concealing supplies an enacted counterpart to the cover located over the audience's eyes.
Eyewitnessing is the access mode that should answer a display but remains unavailable.
The screening cover relocates concealment from the displayed object to the perceiving eye.

structural_cues: 18:100 immediately precedes the relative clause in 18:101 and repeats ʿaraḍa as verb and cognate object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emphatic display, a covering branch for kufr, and covered eyes; I infer a receiver-side failure of recognition. Alternatively, the display may be purely judicial and need not describe an earlier epistemic opportunity.

changed_reading.before: They fail because the warning was not visible or sufficiently presented.
changed_reading.after: The warning may be laid fully before them; the concealment is reproduced in the perceiver's stance and sensory enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah depicts acquired guardianship directed to others besides God. Because focus hearing includes acceptance and obedience, its incapacity can be read as selective routing: allegiance remains active, but not toward the reminder.

activation_trace.role: Taking as an acquisition supplies the deliberate adoption of a relational arrangement.
Otherness or substitution marks the route as displaced from its proper addressee.
Taking charge and governing supplies the alternative authority through which response is routed.
Compliance and following make the denied capacity an allegiance-bearing act, not only a sensory reflex.
Hearing as acceptance and obedience provides the response diverted by substituted guardianship.

structural_cues: 18:102 follows the focus with a false calculation that servants can be taken as awliyāʾ besides God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adopted alternative guardians and hearing as obedience; I infer that allegiance channels receptivity away from the reminder. A live alternative is that false guardianship and failed hearing are parallel charges without a directional link.

changed_reading.before: They lack a general ability to obey.
changed_reading.after: Their capacity for allegiance is occupied elsewhere, making them unable to render the reminder into its proper obedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covered receiver is not inactive: effort strays while its owners calculate that they manufacture well. The work then carries the branch image of swelling from bad intake and finally receives no weight, forming a loop in which blocked correction permits deceptive productivity.

activation_trace.role: Departure from the intended way supplies the misdirection of otherwise active effort.
Supposition or calculation supplies the internal judgment that seals the activity against correction.
Making something as a product supplies visible output that can be mistaken for successful reception.
Bodily swelling from unwholesome grazing supplies a material image of enlarged but corrupted output.
Measured weight tests whether the apparently enlarged work has real substance.
The reminder is the corrective input excluded from the productive loop.
Understanding and acceptance are the missing feedback operation that could redirect the work.

structural_cues: 18:103-105 moves continuously from greatest loss, to confident manufacture, to collapsed works and denied weight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies misdirected effort, self-approval, manufacture, distension, and weighing; I infer a feedback loop in which failure to receive correction lets bad intake become impressive output. Alternatively, these may be sequential verdicts rather than a causal process.

changed_reading.before: Failed hearing leaves them inert and unproductive.
changed_reading.after: Failed receptive hearing can power a self-confirming production system whose swollen output is exposed as weightless.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sea-and-ink sequence makes communicative supply effectively inexhaustible: the medium and its replenishment fail before the words do. Against that abundance, the focus incapacity is a receiver bottleneck, not a shortage of reminder or speech.

activation_trace.role: The vast quantity of sea water supplies the largest local image of communicative material.
Ink that continually supplies a pen turns material extension into a model of sustained transmission.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers identifies the content whose supply outlasts its medium.
Exhaustion and ending test the medium while leaving the words beyond exhaustion.
Effective capacity locates the limiting factor at the receiving side.
Auditory uptake is the narrow endpoint contrasted with the unbounded communicative source.

structural_cues: 18:109 repeats sea, words, and exhaustion before adding another supply, near the close of the same context window.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exhaustible medium, replenishment, inexhaustible words, and focus-side incapacity; I infer that the scarcity lies in reception. A live alternative is that 18:109 magnifies the words without commenting on the mechanics of 18:101.

changed_reading.before: Their failure might reflect insufficient warning or communicative supply.
changed_reading.after: The source can exceed oceanic media; the finite obstruction is the receiver's capacity to let speech become hearing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah places an ordinary visible human surface beside knowledge cast in concealment. The focus coupling of covered eyes and failed understanding can therefore describe fixation at the visible bearer that never receives the hidden disclosure carried through him.

activation_trace.role: The exposed skin or surface supplies the messenger's immediately visible human aspect.
Knowledge cast secretly supplies the nonvisible disclosure that must be received through the visible bearer.
The viewing organ anchors the risk of stopping at what is outwardly visible.
An epistemic cover supplies the failure to pass from surface perception to disclosed meaning.
Understanding and acceptance are the inward uptake that surface fixation fails to achieve.

structural_cues: 18:110 directly juxtaposes 'a human like you' with 'revealed to me' before requiring action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible humanity, hidden disclosure, and the focus's visual-auditory lock; I infer a surface-to-meaning threshold. Alternatively, the ayah does not state that the audience's failure arose from fixation on the messenger's humanity.

changed_reading.before: The cover simply hides an external religious object.
changed_reading.after: The cover may trap perception at the messenger's visible human surface so that concealed disclosure never becomes understood hearing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet's mapped s-ṭ-ʿ branch is form-distant from the dominant ṭ-w-ʿ analysis. It remains anchored to yastaṭīʿūna, the exact split target supplied by the packet, and the adjacent samʿ; downstream prose should call it an exploratory propagation image, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence lā yastaṭīʿūna samʿan joins the split mapped target's rising extension to an act of hearing under an overwhelming cover.

activation_trace.role: Extension or rising through the air supplies a form-distant image of hearing failing to propagate.
An abundance rising over what lies beneath supplies the medium through which propagation fails.
Causing another to hear supplies the outward or transmissive edge of the failed act.

changed_reading.before: The clause only negates an inward faculty.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, no hearing signal rises, extends, or crosses the enclosing medium into a transmissible response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The analogy is cross-root and surprising: ghitāʾ and jannah are not synonyms. It remains valid as a material contrast because both cited branches explicitly cover, while one blocks remembrance and the other forms cultivated lodging; downstream prose should present a contrast of functions, never an etymological equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus specifies not covering in the abstract but a covering positioned away from the reminder.

activation_trace.role: A screening cover supplies the harmful enclosure because its relation is away from remembrance.
A garden covered by vegetation supplies a contrasting enclosure that shelters cultivated life.
Provision prepared for a guest turns the cultivated cover into receptive lodging rather than blockage.

changed_reading.before: Any form of covering is intrinsically deprivation.
changed_reading.after: The decisive feature is the cover's function and relation: one seals perception away from reminder, while another shelters fruitful reception.

strongest_changes: The preceding horn and gathering make samʿ primarily failed responsive uptake rather than simple acoustic deafness.
Emphatic display beside kufr's covering branch relocates concealment from missing evidence to the receiver.
Confident manufacture, bad-intake distension, and denied weight turn the sensory failure into a self-sealing production loop.
The inexhaustible words sequence makes communicative scarcity receiver-side rather than source-side.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became a model of obstructed conversion: visible display and abundant speech remain operative, but reminder cannot cross into recognition, correction, and obedient response. The packet also preserved a form-distant propagation image and a contained contrast between harmful and sheltering covers.
remaining_uncertainties: The horn may gather without requiring any auditory uptake, so it sharpens but does not prove the semantic shift in samʿ.
Alternative allegiance and self-approving work may be consequences or parallel descriptions rather than causes of failed hearing.
The split-root propagation and garden-cover contrast should remain explicitly exploratory in downstream prose.
